ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a D flip-flop, with the left input terminal labeled D, and a clock input C at the lower left; on the right side there are output Q and inverted output \(\overline{Q}\). It can be seen that the Q output terminal is feedback-connected to the D input terminal through the upper wire. Reasoning: The characteristic equation of the D flip-flop is \(Q_{n+1}=D\). Since the feedback line in the figure makes the D input equal to the current output \(Q_n\), after the next clock pulse arrives, \(Q_{n+1}=Q_n\).
